verdict.rationale: Morph has no first-party natural-language command interface of its own, but it ships an official MCP server. That lets agents like Claude Code drive its tools (edit_file, codebase_search, github_codebase_search) from natural-language requests. The quickstart also has users install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can read it while carrying out migrations. Natural-language operation therefore depends on a third-party agent rather than being built into the product. Missing for 10: a native natural-language console or command interface, documented natural-language control of account and endpoint management (canaries, Reflex training, dedicated endpoints), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
